name: competitor-ad-intel
description: Reads competitor ads from the Meta and LinkedIn ad libraries, labels every creative, and builds a branded digest.
long_description: A scheduled-agent-turned-connector for competitive creative research. Scans the public Meta and LinkedIn ad libraries for a configured set of advertisers, has Claude classify each ad's hook, angle and offer against a fixed taxonomy, then renders a branded PDF digest. Treats ad runtime as a performance proxy: an ad live 60 days is an ad that works.

tools.name: add_advertiser
tools.description: Add a competitor to the tracked set.

tools.name: scan_ads
tools.description: Read the public ad libraries and store what's found.

tools.name: get_ads_to_classify
tools.description: Fetch unlabelled ads plus the taxonomy.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.description: Aggregate findings: angle mix, velocity, long-runners.

tools.name: post_digest_to_slack
tools.description: Post the digest to a Slack channel.

prompts.name: weekly_digest
prompts.description: Run the whole loop: scan, label, analyse, render.

prompts.name: messaging_gap
prompts.description: Find unclaimed angles in the category.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: From apify.com → Settings → Integrations. The free tier covers normal use.

slack_bot_token.title: Slack bot token (optional)
slack_bot_token.description: Only needed if you want digests posted to Slack. Scopes: chat:write, files:write.
